Introduction

FIRR is a 5 member hard rock band formed in 2025 by a Korean singer Son Jinwook also known from the band DANGGISIO and participatinon in the Kokkmin Singer and The Nation Calls TV shows.
Two months after debut the band participated in 15th Pyeongtaek Band Contest, where Jinwook won the Best Vocals Award.
